component.name: MenuItem
component.script:
sub init() m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.title = m.top.findNode("title") m.value = m.top.findNode("value") end sub
sub onContent() m.title.text = m.top.itemContent.title m.value.text = m.top.itemContent.description end sub
' The row draws its own pill so it fits exactly and cross-fades as focus moves. sub onFocus() m.bg.opacity = m.top.focusPercent if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.title.color = "0x1A141BFF" m.value.color = "0x1A141BB0" else m.title.color = "0xF0E4D4FF" m.value.color = "0xB5A698FF" end if end sub
